knowledge_point.title: Differentiating a Quotient of Two Polynomials

question.:question/worked-solution:
The numerator and denominator are $u(x)=2$ and $v(x)=- 11 x^{2} - 4 x + 5,$ respectively. Their derivatives are given by

$$
u^{\prime}(x)=0,\,v^{\prime}(x)=- 22 x - 4.
$$

Applying the quotient rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f^{\prime}(x)&=\frac{u^{\prime}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot v^{\prime}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}}\\ &=\frac{(0)\cdot (- 11 x^{2} - 4 x + 5)-(2)\cdot (- 22 x - 4)}{\left(- 11 x^{2} - 4 x + 5\right)^{2}}\\ &=\frac{-(2)\cdot (- 22 x - 4)}{\left(- 11 x^{2} - 4 x + 5\right)^{2}}\\ &=\frac{(2)\cdot (22 x + 4)}{\left(- 11 x^{2} - 4 x + 5\right)^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
